⛔ SNG-456 REVERT LOG — the control-tag review. SAME RULE SHAPE AS PERCEIVE: KEEP the control tag when RESTRICTING THE TARGET IS THE POINT of the rank; STRIP when the restriction is a CONSEQUENCE of damage or of something else.
⚠️ THE DOMINANT PATTERN: `hinder` riding on damage. 'Throw into a group: everyone in the path goes over' is a hit whose consequence is people falling down — the rank is the throw. Same for Radiant Lance r3, The Plain Weight, The Long Odds Come In, Wither, Scatter.
⛔ KEPT: The Sustained Regard (attention AS the restriction), The Contradiction (the interrupt IS the effect), The Standing Word, Boundary-Stone, The Names They Answer To — ranks that exist to stop, hold, compel or forbid.
